summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K extending its subscription rights offering expiration to June 29, 2026, from June 23. Each right entitles the holder to purchase one share of common stock at $6.90 per share, with oversubscription privileges available to basic rights holders. All other terms remain unchanged. The rights, issued June 5, 2026, are transferable and listed on NYSE American under LGL RT. The offering is non-underwritten; Computershare serves as subscription agent. No board recommendation or financial advisor is named. The extension gives additional time for shareholder participation. Watch for take-up levels and any proration if oversubscribed; risk includes dilution if the offering is undersubscribed.
